entities.summary: Gadu-Gadu is a Polish instant messaging client using a proprietary protocol. At its peak, Gadu-Gadu was the most popular IM service in Poland, with over 15 million registered accounts and up to 300 million messages sent per day. In 2010, the service reported over 10 million monthly active users.
